handoff.purpose: Complete requirements for Tsinghua's 83 Fall 2026 undergraduate routes with explicit official tuition.

unresolvedNotes: Scope contains the 83 historical Fall 2026 undergraduate routes whose exact tuition is supported by the locked 2026 fee schedule. The eight Zijing College routes are handled separately under their current Fall 2027 official guide.
This historical Fall 2026 cycle is closed and must not be shown as current.
The four scholarship records remain independent; no route-level entitlement is inferred.

requirements.ruleText: Be a foreign citizen in good physical and mental health, be friendly to China, and hold or be completing a high-school graduation certificate under the published nationality rules.
Create an account, complete the online form, upload every required document, pay the fee and submit within the designated application round.

Upload the applicant's and parents' passport information pages and, when applicable, the applicant's visa and passport pages with China entry stamps. The applicant passport must expire after October 1, 2026.
Upload the applicable original high-school diploma, official pre-graduation certificate with expected graduation date, or university enrollment certificate.
Upload a Chinese- or English-language CV and the applicable original high-school and university transcripts.

HSK 5 with every subscore above 60, or HSK 4 with every subscore above 60 and HSK 5 achieved by the end of the first academic year. A published waiver may apply to native Chinese speakers or applicants educated in Chinese at high school.
Upload the national or regional graduation or matriculation examination certificate and/or available international standardized-test results such as SAT, ACT, A-Level, AP, IB or CSCA.
CSCA is not mandatory for the 2026 intake; optional scores are recommended to include mathematics and physics.
Arrange two recommendation letters through the online system; the system sends its template directly to each recommender's email address.
Upload a personal statement in Chinese or English.
Upload the Financial Sponsor form and the sponsor's employment or income certificate.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with current or former Chinese citizenship or covered parentage/residence circumstances
requirements.ruleText: Submit the published immigration, citizenship cancellation, birth, nationality, parent nationality and overseas residence evidence applicable to the applicant.
Upload a Chinese-and-English self-introduction video no longer than three minutes and smaller than 20 MB in an accepted format.

requirements.appliesTo: Arts Division or Architecture Division applicants
requirements.ruleText: Upload the required portfolio and, for architecture, the form confirming the applicant independently completed the portfolio.
Provide a certificate identifying a legal guardian who currently lives in Beijing and has a source of income.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 800 online application fee.
Meet the applicable round deadline; the final general undergraduate deadline was February 28, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time. Arts Design and Fine Arts routes were open only in the first round.
Participate in Tsinghua's comprehensive assessment when invited. Arts and Architecture applicants also undergo portfolio review, with Arts arrangements notified separately.
Pay the published tuition for this route: RMB 30,000/year.
